selection_rule: highest full-task gain with unchanged motion and physical gates; retain at most two diverse feasible leaders and one informative infeasible diagnostic; freeze before V
methods: legal later-boundary live fork from replayed leader prefix
continuation: original B native physical segments; fixed registered PWL or frozen historical M2 reference
validation_generation: existing legal shared RETURN slot0 K3 prefix, +/-0.005 graph; root at OUTBOUND0, all candidates share prefix; audit actual state at RETURN1, no synthetic state
truth_firewall: current causal observation/model/history logged separately; full future trajectory and J_F only offline teacher labels; no Q training
optional_oracle: only if native stages insufficient and a reusable solver is available within reserved wall/attempt quota
